seed_role: Recorded source-package seed; deterministic date/family assignments use no randomization

policy.calibration: training-only across entire family; exclude if outside chronological training period
policy.unresolved_companions: hold without a split until reviewed in a new version
policy.future_chunks: inherit parent case family and split; never split a family; multi-case annotation packets are not model units
policy.version_changes: New version required for changed cases, labels, families, exposure, or assignment; rerun affected experiments

sample_size_policy.interpretation: Heuristic warnings only; no statistical power established

label_status: provisional; human target/family review remains pending
calibration_coverage: 12 recorded calibration IDs plus family propagation; additional unrecorded prior exposure requires a new version
